dkar chags bcad dang po/ zhu yig 'bul tshul/ yig bskar gyi rnam ba'ag mdo tsam brjod pa me tog phreng ba zhes bya rā bzhugs so// 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtsha/ 1zhu yig 'bul tshul/ bka' blon bshad sgra/ 13sa bcad gnyis pa/ khya yig 'bul ba'i dper brjod/1 bla sprul rigs la 'bul ba/1 gong sa skyabs mgon chen po la 'bul lag bcu bdun/ 16ra kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che la 'bul khag bdun/ 39re rgyal paṇa gnyis la bye brag med pa 'bul khag gcig 474 ris med kyi bla sprul spyi byings la 'bul khag drug 485 rnying ma'i bla sprul la 'bul khag nyi shu rtsa lnga/ 52cu bka' brgyud pa'i bla sprul khag la 'bul khag bco brgyad 734 sa skya pa'i bla sprul khag la 'bul khag nyi shu/ 951

18 lcags la rgyal po la 'bul khag gcig 2351 lcags la chos mdzad la 'bul khag gcig 2364 lha lcam mam dbang mo sogs la 'bul ba/1 lha lcam rigs la 'bul khag bzhi 237shrī sde dge'i dpon mo dang dbang mo sogs la 'bul khag bzhi/ 2415 gnyer mdzod sogs dpon rigs che khag la 'bul ba/1 dngo na rigs la 'bul khag lnga/ 245rngi phyag mdzod la 'bul khag gsum/ 250ri gnyer pa la 'bul khag lnga/ 2534 dmag dpon la 'bul khag drug 2565 mgron gnyer la 'bul khag drug 262cu rdzong dpon dang ska tshab la 'bul khag gsum/ 2676 mdza' bshes thegs snying nye ba'am rang mnyam la 'bul ba/1 rang gi nye grogs la 'bul khag bdun/ 269rngi grogs mo la 'bul khag gnyis/ 273ri pha ma la 'bul khag bzhi/ 274dzo pha mas bu phrug la 'bul khag gnyis/ 2775 rang dang mnyam pa la 'bul khag gsum/ 279dku ming sring bar la 'bul khag bzhi/ 2814

tshi chung ma la 'bul khag gsum/ 2838 bud med kyis mdza' bor 'bul khag gsum 286 gasmon nu pho mo'i mdza' brtse'i 'phrin yig khag drug 2887 gan rgya sogs rgyun mkho'i yig rigs 'ga'/1 bod pa dang ming pa'i domag 'khrugs gcod zugs khag gcig 292rngi e stod dga' ldan rnam rgyal gyi dgung gzhir bka' lan 'bul khag gcig 295ri byang chub gling pa'i dbyar mjal bka' lan 'bul khag gcig 296— smon lam chen mo'i skyabs tho khag gcig 296dku bka' brgyud pa'i chos tshogs la skyabs tho 'bul khag gsum/ 300dku tshe 'das kyi bsngo rten 'bul khag bzhi/ 3034 bsngo rten sogs 'byor lan 'bul khag gcig 3058 rten bzhengs pa'i zhabs 'degs la 'bul khag gcig 305 gnyen ston nam thab gso la 'bul khag gnyis/ 30510 bang ston la 'bul lag gcig 30711 'chi god byung ba la sems gso 'bul khag gnyis/ 30715 'jig rten go phag khab len gyi gnyen yig 'bul khag gcig 3085

13 khrims pa gong ma'i mtshan 'khong kyi gan rgya khag gcig 31 114 gan 'dzin snabs bange 'bul khag gcig 3/ 1sa bcad gsum pa bsngags 'os mchos 'bring gi yul rtsams la 'a yig 'bul ba'i dper brjong blo gros gsar bus 'jub/ sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs so /brje tshul khrims jin chen 313las dang ngo 'i gang zag rnams la snye bar mcho ba'i 'i ga bskar gyi rnam ba'ag malas pa 'i rna rgyan bzhugs so// ci tre 3316

tsam byung na bde/ min yang de'i 'og zhu gsol zhes pa'i bar phreng gcig la zhong tsam bya/ che brjod mang po dang tshigs bcad lta bu phreng gnyis gsum byas nas mtha' yi 'og tu/ zhu gsol dang 'bebs byas kyang chog yig mgor ngos sor bzhi tsam byas na mjug sor gcig gam gnyis sam phyed gnyis lta bu yod par bya/ yig phreng gi bar dog pa zhe sa/ yangs pa zhe sa ma sbyar ba yin/ mdor na stod kyi sa stong dang 'bebs mi sa/ smad kyi sa stong dang yi ge rang gi sa yin pas de lugs kyis dpyad/ khri drung du zhes pa lta bu la gus pas zhu gsol lta bu'i yig mgo khri cayi 'og tu bzhag na zhe sa che/ drung 'og 'bring / du 'og tha ma lta bus rigs bsgros nas/ yig phreng ltag 'og bsgol ba rang gi dbang sogs thob pa'i bla ma'am/ mgo bdag gi dpon chen lta bus mtshon pas zhe sa che/ ma bsnal ba de las ldog phyag tu zer rigs dang rang las dman gras la bkyag phab mi dgos pas dkyas mar bris pas chog go/ ༄gnyis pa yi ge rdzab dang 'bru tsha/ yig chen ni/ bka' shog lta bu dang / gtan 'jags skyu yi ge la sbyar/ de min 'bru chung sgros legs pas bri bar bya'o//gsum pa la yul ches mchog dang / de'i gsham dang / 'bring dang / chen po tsam dang rang dang mnyam pa dang / rang las 2

dman pa la'ang de bzhin bskur ba dang / rang las dman pa la bka' bsgo ba lta bu'i btsan yig gi skabs dang bdun la / dang po bzhi la/thog mar gang la bskur yul gyi che ba brjod pa/ gnyis pa 'dud pa dang bcas pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi tshig gsum pa khams bde ston pa la che ba brjod pa'i tshig bzhi pa rang gi gnas tshul mtshon pa la gong gi bka' drin dran stabs su gyur pa/ lnga pa skabs kyi dngos don la gsol ba 'debs pa/ drug pa slad char dge ba'i rten 'brel zhu ba/ bdun pa de'i zhu mchen gyi rten ming spel ba ste bdun las/dang po yul mchog gi yang rab de'ang chos srid kyi lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho ba gnyis yod pa'i dang po la dper na/ che brjod kyi mthar/ zhabs pad lha brgya'i gtsug gi nor bus bteg pa'i khri 'phang mthon po'i nye drung du/ zhes pa lta bu/ zhabs pad de khri 'phang mthon por bkod nas/ slar rne yang lha brgya'i gtsug gis bsten pa dang / de'i yang nye drung ngam dma' shos su zhes pa lta bu'i zhe sa bzhi btud 'dra'o/ /de'i gsham la zhabs pad lha brgya'i gtsug gis mchod pa'i nye drung du/ zhes pa lta bu/ zhabs pad rkyang ba la mi thug par che brjod byas pa dang / de'i yang nye drung lta bu'i zhe sa gsum btud 'dra ba'o//'bring la/ zhabs kyi padmo mngon par mtho ba'i drung du/ zhes 3

mthus 'byung lus rnal mar gnas shing dge blo ma bor tsam du mchis/zhes pa lta bu dang / 'dris che na/ nang lugs kyis skabs kyi bde dogs smos 'os kun 'bri/lnga pa skabs kyi zhu don la ched du zhu ba lta bu'i drung zhu don bcug la/ thugs rjes mi 'dor bar ska mkhyen mkhyen sogs gsol ba 'debs/ ridrug pa slad ma'i char yang zhes dzi lta bu'i mur ska khams bzang zhing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i tshul rgyan gyi lam nas drangs te༄/ mjug tu de ltar 'gyur bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags na thugs rjes re 'bras don smin du mdzad par 'tshal/ zhes pa lta bu sogs skyabs zhus dang shis brjod ji mdzes bya yig lan lha bu yin na ska khams bzang ba'i ngos nas gsung bris kyi rgyun mi chad par stsol ba rgyan sgro lam nas drangs te bya/bdun pa snga ma dang sbrel te thugs brtses rjes su skyong ba'i rten 'brel zhu mtshon du bkra shis pa'i lha reg sogs rnam grangs bris te gus phul lam sa gnas che ge mo nas zla tshes 'di la phul zhes pa tsam las/zhe sa che ba dgos gras la 'bul mkhan gyi ming mi bri/ gal te 'bri na phyi ru bri bar bya'o/ /de 'a phul zhes pa lta bu la gong gi man rgyan dang 'tshams par gus par phul lta bu rnams mas rims su bsegs nas brtsegs te bzhi bab pa rab/ tha na'ang dkyus mar bris pa'i phul gyi 5

skabs don so sor shan phye nas brda 'phrod pa mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bu dang / snying gtam dang dbugs 'byin pa sogs la tshad nang la ga bur thebs pa lta bu dang / snying nye ba la bskur na ma bu sa mtha' nas phrad pa lta bu sogs/ skabs su babs pa/ gnad du song ba/nyams phun sum tshogs par bya'o//lnga pa rang mnyam pa la dbu 'jug 'di lta bu dkyus ma'i mthar/brtse ldan dang / shes ldan sogs gang 'os kyi phyag tu'am/ drung du'am/ ga la bar zhes pa'i mthar 'bebs med par phul don lta bu'i mur/ de gar khams 'tsho ba sogs dga' tshul dang / rang gi gnas tshul/ skabs don/ slad cha rten bcas che ge mo nas phul/zhes don tshan snga ma ltar la/ zhes ha cang mi dgos pa'i khyad par ro//'phral rdon la phul dang / skabs don smos pas chog pa sogs dus dang sbyar/ drug pa rang las dman gras la'ang / shes ldan sogs bshad ma thag pa ltar la chig rtsa rkyang ba bri/ yon tan cung zad yod pa'am/yul bla ser sogs mchod gnas kyi rigs la rang las dman pa la'ang 'dud pa dang / zhe sa sbyar ba la skyon med par ma zad/ legs pa yin no// bdun pa la dang po gang gi bka' bsgo ba po'i gta / gnyis 7

pa gang la bskar ba'i yul smos pa/ gsum pa skabs don dngos/bzhi pa khrims bsgrog pa/ lnga pa yul dus gang du bris pa go bar bya ba las dang po la dbu 'dzugs gang bdes chog kyang / deng sang khams dbus kyi 'phral bskar gyi phyag bzhes la/ lha bu 'di'i rtse ji tsam ring bor byas nas shorsha bu'i mtha' ji tsam non pa de tsam kheb rgya che bar brtags/ gang ltar yang / rgya bod kyi rgyal po che gras kyis/rang gang gi thob thang dang bstan pa'i gtam rngam zil dang bcas te che ge mo nas zlo ba zhes sam/ 0 che ge mo'i gtam zhes pa lta bu'i 'og tu bkyag phab byas nas gnyis pa yul sde mi ris che ge mo la zhes sam nge dag la zlo ba/ spring ba/ bskar ba rnams thob thang dang che chung dang rim pas sbyar te bri ba sogs bya/ ca dper na/ gnam bskos gong ma chen po'i bka' lung gis bod khams yongs kyi rje bor mnga' gsol ba 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rjer 0bod pa'i gtam/ zhes pa lta bu'i 'og tu bkug phab dang bsnal tshul sngar yul dang po dang phyogs 'dra bar byas la/ dbus gtsang khams kyi mi sde mtha' dag la zlo ba'am kun nas nges par bya rgyur sogs nas skabs don sbyar zhing / gsum pa don tshan du yod pa bri/ bzhi pa don tshan gyi rnam pa du yong pa de dag las nyes 'gal phra mo tsam shar tshe rgyal khrims 'di 'dra ba la sbyar zhes pa dang / sdeb ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge yul dus che ge mo la bris zhes ḍi

pa lta bus mtshon te shes par bya zhing / rgyal phran phal ba rnams kyis dang po nas bskar yul gyi ming smos la don tshan bsgrags nas snga ma bzhin nam/ yunā dus la stos nas khrims bsgrags dgos mi dgos tshig rtsa gnang du phab lugs sogs ci rigs yong pa shes par bya zhing / chod khru sogs skul la/ gtan tshig bzhag don zhes sam/ kun nas nges dgos rgyur sogs tshing/ gi bab sna tshogs yod pa yin no//bzhi pa mi nor ba'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul la/ gdab bya rgya ni/rang dang lha'i ming dang phyag mtshan bkra shis pa'i rdzas la sogs pa'i the'u 'am bla dpon chen po ngag gis las sgo'i rtags su gnang ba'am/'dul ba dang mthun par mi sngag pa'i 'du shes gso ba keng rus kyi gzugs la sogs pa ji 'os shā/ de yang gzhong 'bur gyi khyad par gyi la cha dang snag spar la bsngags pa gang rigs/ kha dog kyang bla dpon chen po dag gi rma tshal/ de las gzhan pa'i snag gis bya'o/ /gdab lugs zhe sa byed na khams 'dir nang thel bya srol med/ phyi ru phul lta bu'i tsheg dang 'brel bar mir dgu nyams su gdab/ zhu khru sogs la thel mi dgos/ rang dang mnyam pa sogs la ji bder bya bka' shog la nang gi dang por gtam zer ba lta bu'i rjes su bka' rtags bzhag pa'am/ stod kyi sa stong du yi ge phreng dang po che ge mo'i gtam zhes pa'i 'og tu gdab la khyung 'brug sogs che rgu'i lag par nor 9

gzhong sogs su mchod stabs bya/ de bas che ba mtshon par byed/mjug thel gdab na'ang mar dgu nyams kyis tha ma'i 'bru re gnyis sgon par gdab/ mthar gdab pa tsheg dang 'brel ba des tshig stong don gyis non pa mtshon zhing / khyad par 'gru re gnyis non pas tsha drag yod par mtshon/ spyir mjug thel yod rigs don de ba gas par mtshon no/ /phyag rgya 'di ni mi nor bar rang gi rtags te gdab bya'i don de las mi 'da' bar mtshon pa yin no//lnga pa ltab lugs la/ zhe sa thob pa rnams la smad nas yar dril/de'ang nyis steb chen po med par sne nas dril/ de min la yi ge'i mjug nas yar gyed du dril/ bka' shog la mjug gi steb re gnyis bar nyis lteb bya/ zheng ci tsam che ba de tsam shog dril lteb chung / bka' shog lta bu la steb zheng che/ de ltar bris zin pa'i shog dril de yang /zhe sa che ba la sum steb sne bkug pa'i sne ji tsam ring ba/ zhe sa dang /zhe sa tsam la sum bltabs/ de nas rim pas thung ba dang / mnyam pa bzhi bltabs sogs ji bde/ bka' shog la nyis bltabs mjug ngogs thung ba bya/ de ltar bltabs pa'i shog bu sne gnyis so sor mnyam par dras la/ shog bu'i ya mtha' yod ngos rgyab tu byas te snyi logs su bkug de la sum lteb lta bu la/ dang por rang gi ming bris nas/des phul ba'i zhu yig gam gus phul sogs bri/ spyir zhe sa dgos gras 10

la/ rang gi ming gar dgos kyi gnas su phran dang / phran chung lta bu sbyar/ zhe sa mi dgos na ngos dang / bdag la sogs zer/ bka' zhog sogs la nged nas dang / 'di nas sogs brjod/ ched sbu sogs la/ chod khu dang / la yig lta bu ming tsam 'bri ba'am/ gyi thel byed na bka' shog sogs btsan yig la/ 'phral du sprod lta bu'i mthar brdeg bar ba la/ zhe sa dgos gras la nang gi mgo rgyang ltar zhabs drung dang sku drung sogs gang rigs mdor bsngas sbyar/ gsum lteb tha ma nang ma byas te sne bkug pa sogs bya/ zloka' zhog sogs la steb dang che ge mo la sprod sogs bri/ skabs 'dir hang thag dkri lugs kyi rnam bzhag yod kyang khams 'dir ma dar bas bzlog/drug pa rten bcas 'god tshul la/ dar dang ṭam ga lta bu nang du tshud rigs min pa gzhan du rtags ldan bcas te bzhag de yang dar lta bu la/ ri mo mgo 'jug ma log par ye ge ltar bya/ de yang nyis steb dang bzhi steb pa yi ge'i che chung dang mtshams par byas la/ yi ge dril bar bya'o//bdun pa dam rgya gdab lugs ni/ yongs grags ltar la/ de yang zhe sa che ba la/ nang gi yi ge rten bcas kyi dmis zheng gsum tsam bya/ ya khebs che ba the sa/ de la ya khebs kyi ༄ngos la nang gi mgo rgyang ltar brjod pa'i zhabs drung du/ zhes pa lta bu'i mtha' dkyil du 11

mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i zhabs stegs mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mngon mtho'i drung du/sgo gsum gus 'bangs (ming smos) nas sor bcu'i 'dab ma spyi bor bkod de lha phyag grangs med dang bcas te zhu gsol 'debs snying /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i mi yi rol gar 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i gsang gsum mtshan dpe'i mchog ska rdo rje'i khams ltar brtan brjod chags shing / ji snyed gdul bye'i khams bzhin sna tshogs sprul pa'i rol gar gyis bdag cag bod 'bangs rnams chos srid gnyis kyi sgo nas 'tsho zhing skyong ba'i bka' drin ni bdag gzhan lus longs spyod dus gsum dge rtsa dang bcas pa stong gsum rin chen bdun gyis bskangs te bskal brgyar 'bul yang bka' drin cha tsam gzhal bar dka'/ mgon po gang gi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba skyabs 'og pa gus 'bangs rnams lus sems ci bder gnas mus su mchis lags/ mtshams su zhu gsol 'debs snying / (don bkod) slad ma'i char yang gang nyid 'gro ba spyi dang / khyad par kha ba ri pa rnams kyi mgon dpung dam par ska tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing / chab 'bangs rnams /lha bcu'i khrims kyi dpal la skal bzang bde skyid longs su spyod thub pa dang / gus 'bangs bdag kyang 8

par lham me lhan ni lhang nger gsal zhing / gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i 'phrin las ngo mtshar bye ba phrag brgya'i 'dzum zer mtha' klas kyi zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtshor 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bka' drin ni stong gsum rin chen bdun gyis bskang yang gzhal ba'i yul las 'das par gyur/ skyabs mgon srid zhi'i rnam 'dren chen po'i thugs rje'i skyabs rol du gus 'bangs kyang 'byung khams la gsar slad med cing / bsam yas chos 'khor chen po'i legs gso'i zhabs 'degs la 'bad brtson khul du mchis/ mtshams su phyag dang bcas te zhu gsol/ stod 'grel gyi brda' las yongs 'dzin zhes pa bre kha'i mig can gsher 'dzin mdzes ma'i khams kyi lang tsho dang / 'grogs pa'i bkra shis gnam lo'i dge mtshan gsar du ngoms pa'i dga' ston chen po'i mdun sar rten cing 'brel 'byung gi sarga mi 'chol ba'i slad du rab dkar lha rdzas bstan pa'i bdag po'i ska brnyan na bza' can/ bzang gos bum ldan ma yug li yug marsha tse yug bcas 'bul lam zhus pa dag pa ye shes chen po'i mjing mtshor yud tsam smin pa dang / slad ma nyid du'ang bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan dang bde ba'i srog shing chen por zhabs pad rtag brtan gzhom zhig bral ba rdo rje'i chos bdun gyi ngo bor bskal pa grangs med du mar g.yo ba med cing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i snyan rnga phyogs kyi 'dzin mas brdung ba'i skal bzang yongs la khyab gdal 23

dhe gas 'phrog byed ngabang po brgyad kyis btegs pa 'i rnar bu'i khri 'phang mngon par mtho ba'i drung du sgo gsum gus pa chen pos lha phyag dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa'i sdi nga po sna ska la bzang zang mi shes pa'i dus kyi char 'dir snang stong zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rdo rje'i dwangs ma rang gzugs su shar ba'i sgyu 'phrul bye ba phrag brgyar sgo ngang bsnga ba'i brtse 'jos zhing khams thams cad dog por khyab pa'i rol pa las smyoXs 'di'i spyi mthun bsong nams dgung mkhar shar ba'i gsang gsum rgyan gyi bkod pa srid pa'i sgron me lha ngang bcas pa'i skye ṅga kun gyi bla mar lham me lhan nee lhang nger gsal zhing / tshad du ma dmigs pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'od zhugs ring por thab bstan 'dab brgya 'dzum pa'i dge legs kyi zil marngar lus can ra yig gnyis/ pa'i khyu tshogs dbugs dbyung ba'i mchog sbyin 'khor lo 'khor yug tu stsol bzhin pa'i thog lha dang mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas gangan sa chen po ches 'khor rgyal du zhabs zung bkra shis 'khor lo'i re la bkong zin pa'i bka' drin gyi tshang ni stong gsum rin chen bdun gyis bkang yang gzhal bya'i yul las 'das/skyabs mnan lha mi'i 'a dren mchos chen po'i thugs rje'i grib bsil du gus 'bangs 'byung khams la gsar slad med cing 'phrin las zhabs 'debs la gus brtson du mchis/ mtshams su zhus pa chen pos phyag 25

sgo gsam gus pa chen pos lha phyag grangs med dang bcas te zhu gsol 'debs snying / rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi brtse chen bdud rtsi'i snying po ba peṃ lag gi rnam par shar ba 'phags chen phyag na pad mo'i gsang gsum rdo rje rin po che'i lhun po khyad chos bdun ldan gyi ngo bor lhan chags shing / gang 'dus 'phrin las kyi gzi byin lhar bcas skye rguna'i gdung sel rda phyong/sa gyi 'khor lo kun la khyab pa'i dge mtshan nam yang mi lhod pa'i dbyings nas gus 'bangs chung du thugs rje'i dpyang thag gi stong padhe med pa'i bka' tham rin po che gnang rten gsung mdud phur 'byar/ rdo rje'i rgo zab dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal mchog bdun pa chen po'i na bza' dang / bzang gos gyon 'dang bcas bde legs 'khor lo'i mdzes rgyan du smin pa bsam gtan dang po'i rtse dga' spu reg par gyur pa bka' drin mchog tu che che zhu/ mgon po gang gis skyabs rol du gus chung yang gsar slad med tsam nas zhi drag zhabs 'dogs spu lhag bsam stod pa med par mchis/ mtshams su phyag dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs snying / slad ma nyid 'gro ba spyi dang / khyad par kha ba ri pa rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam par mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs 'bar ba'i ska mchog bde can mgon po'i rnga bor bskal brgyar g.yo ba med pa /sa gas 'bangs kyang thugs rje'i 'ching thag mi lhod pa'i rjes 'dzin bka'i gnang ba chad med yan lag mchog gi 28

rgya mtshos rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char yang chos kyi dbyings zab mo gsang ba gsum gyi mi khyab pa'i ngang nas rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i ngo mtshar phan bde'i snying po 'ba' zhig spya 'char ba'i gsang gsum rdo rje'i khams su brtan cing / ris su ma chad pa'i gdul bya rnams byang grol gyi sa lam bzang por yongs su dkri ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa du mas yol ba mi mnga' bzhin du brtan chags pa'i dga' ston 'khor mo yug tu spyod pa nyid las gsar tshes gnam lo'i rang zhal thog mar ngoms pa'i dus ston phun sum tshogs pa'i thog srid zhi'i dge mtshan gyi dngos po mtha' dag phyogs gcig spya 'du ba'i rjes 'brel du yul 'di zhes bya ba nas legs lam rten 'byung gi dngos po tho chung zur gsal bzhin 'bul lam zhus pa ji ltar dang ji snyed pa'i gnas lugs kun la chags thogs med pa'i spyan dkyus utpal sngon po'i 'bab stegs su yud tsam dgongs dang / ji srid nam mkha'i nor bu snang bas 'tsho ba de srid du zhabs zung rtag brtan g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du 'tsho zhing gzhes la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi mngar pos mngon mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa'i lam bzang por dbugs dbyung ba'i bka' drin gyis 'phral yun du bskyang bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ zhu yig spyan sngar smin byed bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas la rtags chung gis spud de gral tshes mchog tu gus phyag dang 31

gyi skyabs gnas ngam pa mchog gi zhabs drung du/gus pas phyag bcas zhu gsol/ rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char yang tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po'i 'jings zab las thar pa'i mdzes ska'i lhan po mtshan dope'i bang rim gyis mngon spar mdzes shing / gdul bye glinge bzhi'i dbus na tshad med pa'i 'phrin las phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang spyod yul mtshungs par bdag gir bzhes pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi phan bde'i 'dod pa yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i bka' drin bla na med par gyur lags/ gsol ba 'debs pa'ang glo bur ba'i nyer 'tshes ma gos bzhin lhag bsam dge ba'i 'khar ba ma bor tsam na gnas lags/ mtshams kyi gsol ba 'bebs don/zhes sogs kyi mtshams sbyar nas/ don 'bri bar bya'o/ /slad du'ang bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa zhabs pad rtag brtan g.yung drung gi rang bzhin du g.yo ba med cing zab rgyas rnam par ngagi ba'i 'phrin las mkha' khyab tu 'char bar gsol ba 'debs par re ba yid bzhin du bskang ba'i bka' drin chen pos rjes su skyong ba dang / rmongs rtal bdag kyang 'di phyi gnas skabs thams cad du brtse chen ye shes kyis byā gzigs pa nas/ mi bor ba'i bka' bstsal gyi rim pa 'chi med dal 'gro'i klang rgyan bzhin 'phral yun da stsol ba mkhyen lags/ 'a 'degs sogs /bri'ozhu// ༄ ༄33

dad pa'i sor mo spyi por zum pas btud de zhu ba/ rnam par dge ba'i dus kyi char yang / tshad med pa'i zhing khams rgya mtshor ska gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bkod cupa mkha' khyab tu mchis pa nyid las/ khyad par du zhing 'di'i gdul bya thun mong ba dag gi snang ngo dang mtshungs par 'jug pa'i gzugs ska'i dkyil 'khor lhan po'i do zlar 'phags pa nas phan bde'i snying po cagan gyi mdzad pa kusna tu bzang po'i rang bzhin gyi dge mtshan mngon par gsal bzhin par 'tsho gzhes g.yo ba med pa ni bstan pa dang sems can mtha' dag pa'i phan bde'i srog bzung bla na med par gyur par bka' drin gyi dpal las che/ gang gi tshad med thugs rjes nye bar 'tsho ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa'ang gsar 'tshe med cing chos bzhin sems pa'i mos blo ma por tsam du gnas lags/ deng gi tshe rigs can gdul bya rgya mtsha'i mos blo dang nye bar mtshams pa'i zab dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i sgo brgya lhug par phye ste byang grol gyi lam bzang por bkro ba'i mdzad pa 'byams tshos su brtas pa ni bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag gi don gyi snying po bla na ma mchis par nges pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gis mchod legs 'bul dngos 'byor gyi mtshad sprin cha phra mo tsam zhig skye khra zur gsal bzhin 'bul lam zhus pa spyan ras kyi gzigs ngor btsa' ba dang / slad du'ang 35

gzhan dobang gi gang bdul sprul pa'i rol gar yongs su gsal bar mdzad pa ni chos kyi sku 'a sa ma g.yos par sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyi zhes sogs kyi tsung don dang mthun par/ nye ba'i char yang gangs can gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag ska bsod nams chen pos gdul bya'i phyir du mtshan dang dpe byad kyi ༵ shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i ska'i bkod pa bdag sogs skye 'gro mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams kyi zhidro mchog dam par gsal bar mdzad de/ gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i dbus/ srid na che rga kun gyi mnga' gsol skal ba bzang por longs spyong chog pa 'di dag ni thegs rje bka' drin gzhal phyir zhabs brtan legs 'bul mtshon byed tsam du bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi re khas bkra ba'i lha rdzas dang rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa'i masal snang sring sdod bcud kyi yon tan thams cad lhan gyis grub pa'i tshom bu dar lnga'i rgyan 'phyang ba ska rten rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i snang brnyan/ gsung brten rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i theg pa chen po'i mdo/ thugs rten pad spungs mchod rten zhal dkar stegs bcas/ zhal bsil bzed zhal/ dbu paṇa/ sku bor rung tshon gyi sbags pa'i ska chos ska gzan/ ska thang / ska rags/ ska bcar mo/ bzhu/sa rdzing snga/ ska mnye( kha dkar dang༄ bcas pa zhugathe gdan/ stan dkar rdo rje'i re gakha can bcas 'bul ba lags na brtse 37

mtha' dang bral ba chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i klong las dag pa'i rang mdangs spros mtshan snying rje'i rang gzugs zhing 'di'i bstan 'gro'i mkha' dbyings su shar ba'i gsang gsum kun phan dkyil 'khor mtshan dpe'i cha shas yongs su gang bzhin par lham me lhan nee lhang nger gsal zhing ris su ma chad pa'i gdul bya'i zhing la stoms par 'jug pa'i thugs rje dang bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i 'dzum phreng dkar pos phan bde'i bsil sbyin 'dod rgu 'jo bzhin par 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i dbyings nas bka' tham rin po che gnang rten lha gos dang /sman rtse yug bcas phyag rgya'i gzi byin 'bar ba spyi bo phebs pa ni bka' drin gyi dpal yon dam par gyur/ skyabs mgon yab zas kyi thugs rjes gus phran kyang gzugs khams bde zhing rgyal khab chen po'i zhabs 'dregs la 'bad brtson khul du mchis lags/ mtshams su phyag bcas zhu gsol/ slad ma'i char yang / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i spyi dpal chen por zhabs zung rdo rje rin po che'i rtse brgya 'bar ba'i ngo bor bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar g.yo ba mi mnga' ba brtan par bzhugs te/gang gdul mos ngo dang 'tshams pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i 'phrin las kyi dge mtshan mkha' khyab tu skyong ba'i dbyings nas thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi skyabs rol nas mi skyung pa'i rjes 'dzin gyi bka' slob bzang po dal 'gro rnam bzhi'i rgyun bzhin spyi bor stsol ba mkhyen/ mkhyen/ zhu 4 ’

mnga' brnyes pa mchog gi zhabs pad du/gus gsol/ deng dge mtshan 'bum phrag 'phel ba'i dus kyi char yang / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis lha lam yangs par ska mchog gnam gyi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor mtshan dpe'i gzi mdangs rgyas shing / thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'bum phra dkrigs te zab rgyas chos kyi char pa phabs te bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i lo tog bskrun par mdzad cing chos spyod thugs dam gong 'phel du bzhugs pa'i ngos nas phran rnams la mgo 'dren thugs rjes mi 'dor ba ni shin tu nas kyang bka' drin che lags/ 'di na gus pa sbyin bdag gi tha shal ba rnams kyang mchog gsum spyi dang khyad par 'dus tshogs rin po che'i thugs rje la brten nas 'gal rkyen bar chad med par bde bar gnas pa'i skabs lags/mtshams zhu/ ched gsol/ (don bkod/) slad mar bkra shes dge mtshan rgyas pa'i char yang sku mchog rnams gser gyi ri dbang ltar brtan cing / rnam dkar chos spyod thugs dam ting 'dzin dbyar mtsho ltar gong 'phel du bzhugs pa'i ngos nas phran rnams la thugs dam bsrung 'khor skyabs 'og nas nam yang mi 'dor zhing / bka' mchid gsung gi bdud rtsi'i phebs tshogs chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyan ltar spyi por stsol ba mkhyen mkhyen/ mkhyen lags zhes spyan rlom du 'degs rten mtshon byed stong min tsam du bcas zla tshes bzang por54

cing g.yo zol mi mnga' ba'i rnam thar mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sprin chen po mngon par bres pas/ ma brgal ba rnams bsgral/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba sogs tshad dang mu med pa'i smon lam dang thugs bskyed kyi go cha btsan pos nye bar g.yogs pa'i rang 'bras lhun gyis grub pa khyab par brdal bas/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i nye bar len pa las 'das kyang / gzung du med pa chu zla'i rol par shar ba'i gsang gsum phul du byung ba'i beḍūrya/ 'gro blo'i rnyogs pas ma sbugs par/ 'di dang gtan gyi 'dod pa ma lus pa 'jo ba'i dpal du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa nas bka' glegs padma rā ga'i phyag rgyas btab cing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od ma gud pa spyi bor stsol thob/ dang po'i sa la rkang stegs 'jog pa'i dga' ba'i rol tshims shing dad pa'i spu langs shin tu g.yos par gyur lags/ skyabs 'og 'khod pa'i stoms las pa'ang / rgyal mchog rnams kyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i grib bsil dpag par dka' ba la ngal 'tsho thob pas lang tsho'i me tog dus kyi ba mos ma rnying par/ lugs gnyis rdul dmar ci dgar rol pas/ skal mnyam gyi bung ba gzhon nu 'ga' zhig tshims pa skyed pa'i zol du mchis/mtshams kyi zhu don/ slad kyi char yang chos kyi rgyal po ma pham lha brgya'i mgon pos theg gsum chos kyi char pa kun tu phab pa de srid du/ skye 'gag gnas pa kun dang bral ba mi shigs mkha'i phyag rgyar rtag tu mdza' 76

byang chub pa dang / zhing yongs su sbyong ba sogs thabs mkhas kyi khyad par sgro 'phrul rgyan gyi rol mo bsam las 'das pas/ 'gro ba'i lus dang 'tshams par ska sprul/ tshig tu bsgrags pa'i chos bstan/ yid dang mthun par thunas kyi 'jug pa ste gsang gsum gyi spyod yul mkha' ltar 'byams su klas pa las/ gangs can bstan 'gro'i legs byas shar ri'i phrag par 'thon pa'i sku 'tsho'i nyin byed 'grib pa med par lham mer gsal zhing / mun par 'phun pa rnams kyi dmigs bu/ yang dag pa'i lam stor ba rnams kyi snang byed gcig pur 'tsho zhing gzhes pa nas/ gsung gi re khra phyag rgya ma nyams pa tshangs gnas kyi rgyan du son pas/ mi phyed pa'i gdung shugs kyis drangs pa'i dad spro'i gardo khong nas dgod par gyur lags/ gus 'bangs sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa'i pad tshal du bsti ba'i bung ba'i na chung yang / 'jigs dang sdug bsngal gyi ser bas ma gtses par lugs gnyis rang sgra zang zing du 'byin bzhin mchis/ mtshams zhu/ slad du'ang / thar mchog rin chen gling du 'jug par 'dod pa rnams kyi ded dpon/ rtag tsam 'dzin pa'i mun pas gdung ba'i snang byed/ nyes brgya'i rba klong du 'phyan pa rnams kyi gru gzengs gcig pu phar rgyun gyis rtag pa la/ mi rtag pa byis blos mtshan mas ma bsgribs par ji srid nyi zla'i bgrod pas snang ba'i bya ba byed pa de srid rtag cing brtan te theg mchog 'khor lo rgyun 78

gcod pa la brtul zhugs rlabs su che ba'i zung 'jug grub pa rnams kyi tshogs kyi gtso dang dbang phyug dam par snang ste/ legs par gsungs pa'i bka' rab 'byams la lung chen thob pas chos kyi phung po spyi dang /bye brag sgrab brgyud rin po che'i gsang ba'i gan mdzod rang dbang du mdzad narsha gdams zab rin thang med pa'i nor bu'i dpal gyis lus can ma lus pa'i dbul ba sel ba la shes bya'i khongs na mtshungs zla thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa nas/dpang rtags phyag rgyas 'khyud pa'i bka' glegs rin po che gtsug tu phebs pas/ 'brug spas myos pa'i gtsug phud can bzhin dad gdung spro ba'i nyams kyis re zhig brtol med par gyur lags/ snying po'i bstan pa'i zham rings su rloms pa bdag kyang / rtag gus sbyor ba stod pa min pas bstan dang 'gro phan gyi byang chub spyod mchog rnam pa lam byed spyod pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi rang mdangs dang / rgyal mchog yab sras rnams kyi byin rlabs zla zer snying la zhugs pas nye tho'i mtshan mo'i pags pa dbul zhing / legs dgu'i chu gter rim gyis rgyas par bdog mtshams su zhu mchid/ slad ma'i char yang / don brgyud nges pa'i bdag po dbyar rngas shin tu sgeg pa'i mtshan brgya'i gdugs dkar gcig gis/lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu zag pa dang bcas pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag las skyob ste/ ma rgyal ba rnams rgyal ba dang / ma rtogs pa rnams 86

rin po che'i zhabs drung du/dwangs pas zhu gsol/ deng yang gdod ma nyid nas goms pa'i thugs bskyed kyi rgya mtsho ltar mi mngon pa la 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa'i 'khor lo yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpyid du brtan cing 'khor 'das thams cad kyi byed po tha mal gyi shes pa dus gsum gyi rtogs brjod dang bral ba bzhugs pas ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub cing / dam par ci yang 'char ba'i ska gsum gyi ma dang mjal ba'i ma hā mu dra'i gsang sgo 'gro ba kun gyi 'jursha ngogs su 'gyed pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rnam par yangs pa bzhugs pa ni bka' drin bla lhag tu che che lags/ 'dir gnas pa'ang sgyu lus kyi 'byung ba stoms shing rgyu dang 'bras bu'i las kyi rnam bzhag ma nor spyod pa'i shes rab kyi mig ma ldong tsam du gnas/ mtshams zhu/ slad mar skyos kun bden med kyi lta ba 'dzin med goms pa bde gsal gyi rnal 'byor g.yo med rjes su thob/ shugs 'byung gi spyod pa 'gag med kyi bshad srol bzang pos sang rgyas lag bcang du sbyin pa'i mgon du gzugs ska'i snang brnyan nor 'dzin bu mo rgya mtsho ska rags ma grol ba 'gogs ཿden zhi ba'i mal du mi zims shing shes bya'i 'khor lo thams cad bde chen phyag rgya chen bo'i ngang du 'ching ba'i thugs rje'i gri 'phrul gyi rol gar kun tu ba nga por shar ba nas sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa nyi 89

gus pas zhu mching/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dang / rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po zung du 'jug pa'i 'pho med dga' ba ji snyed pas/ 'pho ba'i dbugs nge snyed bkag ste khyab bdag gi rim pa ba spu'i mthar thug 'phel bas ye shes srog tu grub pa'i nyin mor byed pa'i ska gcig gis mkha' khyab mkha'i zhing dang ska tshad med par snang bar mdza/ pa las pad ma 'dab ma rgyas pa'i gzugs gyi snang brnyan 'gro sems beeḍū ru'i sa gzhir gtsang mar shar bas gdul dbugs dbyung bar mdzad de 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i bka' drin rab dga'i dga' ba la sna 'dri bar 'gyur 'dir yang skyabs gsum thugs rje'i byin mthus sgyu lus kyi lang bu nye 'o'i thigs pas ma brtsam par/sgrab brgyud bstan 'dzi na che dogu'i gral gsham du snyegs par rtsam ste 'khor zlo gnyis kyi bya ba ci rigs par skabs babs su 'jug bzhin mchis mtshams zhu/ 'byung 'gyur gyi char yang sngon byung dpa' bo'i dbang phyag dag gis snying po'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rgyal dbang padmo ka ra'i phrin las shing rta'i kha lo phyogs brgyar sgur ba la ngal ba med pa'i g.yar dam brtan po bzhes pa lags na seng stobs kyi go cha btsan por snyigs lngas skyo ba'i mtshon gyis nam yang ma rmas par/ 'chi med rdo rje'i gnyug ma'i lang tshor bgres chad spangs pa'i rtag pa chen por bzhugs late/ gzhom med chos sgra zab camos glo bur gyi 'ching pa bcad 91

'phags kyang / de nyi da du zhi ba'i bde ba la mi gnas pa slar yang bsam bzhin sri nga pa'i rnam rol du ston pa ni thugs bskyed gyi snying po kho na lags pa bzhin deng 'dir skye ba sprul ska'i 'dzum zhal thub bstan lhan po'i mdzes rgya na du byon pa'i ngakyil 'khorazhu sgrib g.yogs meng pa gsarag du ngoms pa'i gtam snyan bdung rtsir thos ma thag tu bsam bzhin bka' drin la ngad gus kyi spa sgong rab tu g.yos par gyur/ da lam thog ma'i rten 'brel gyi mtshon byed du bkra shis pa'i rab dar dkar lha rdzas rgyal ba tshe ngapag meng kyi snang brnya na na bza' bcas 'bul lam zhus pa dgyes bzhes ngos/ mi ring ba mkhas mang klu dbang stong phrag ngagyes dgur rol pa'i chu gter chen po legs bshad rdza rnga sgrogs pa'i khyu mtshag dam ji mnga' gsol ba'i dus skabs kyi sngon tshung nas bzung rten cing 'brel 'byung gi zhu mching dang 'bul mtshon bcas zhib cha rim bzhin phul chog pa dang / skyes bu chen po rna mas kyi 'khung du babs pa sna/ thub pa'i bstan pa ridzin pa dang / 'gro ba rnams 'phral yun gyi phan bde la 'gong pa kho na nyid yin zhing snyigs dus rgyud pa'i mu na pas snad bcud kyi dkyil 'khor mthab dag log par byeng pa'i dus 'dir thugs rje'i 'od dkar shugs drag tu skye ba'i dus las babs pa gdon mi za bas na/ bla rdo rī gyi tshig 'di ngag legs par bshad pa'i mchod sprin du rngo mi thogs kyang / byis pas ma yi gam da smra zhing 'dod gangang ṅga 'a mching zol med lags pa mkhyen ༄ ༄ ༄ 11(

mchog tu gus pas nye bar brgyud de zhu gsol/ deng 'dir sa la spyod pa'i chos ldan rgyal po rnams ni 'phags chen rgyal ba'i zas kyi thugs rje'i sprul bkod du gsung pa bzhin gtan la phab pa'i rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun sngon du 'gro bas yangs pa'i sa chen por bdag gir mdzad de/ ris bral rgyal ba'i bstan pa de 'dzin dang bcas pa bla nas thar 'degs shing / phyogs bral dregs ldan mtha' dag rang dbang du brjid la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba dang / byams brtse'i skya rengs kyi kha los nye bar drangs pa'i dge bcu'i phrin las kyi snang ba chen pos yangs pa'i 'bangs kun rdzogs ldan nyin mo'i dpal la yongs su sbyor te mi bsrun 'byung bya mtha' dag ming med du btang ba sogs mes dbon gsum gyi rnam thar ltar bzhes pa'i snyan grags dbyar gyi rnga gsang phyogs bcur ldir bzhin pa nas gzugs ska mchog gi 'tsho gzhes dkar phyogs kyi sde thams cad phyogs las rnam ther rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan du mngon par brtan bzhugs ni bka' drin dang bsod nams kyi phung po zad mi shes pa thob lags/'dir gus pa'ang skyabs gnas rin chen gsum dang rje rgyal dam pa mchog gi thugs rje'i ngal 'tshor thob bzhin mchis lags/ mtshams zhu/ slad mar yang / 'byams klas bstan dang 'gro ba yongs la snyigs ma rnam lnga'i g.yul ngo bag bsrings te/ dge mtshan phan bde'i dga' ston la spyod chog pa ni dam pa nyid kyi bka' drin nyag gcig las grub pa 327

sngon tshe o ṭi yā na padmā ka ra'i dam tshig rdo rje'i lung gi mnga' nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams shing rgyas su 'phel ba dang bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs gang ci mchis chos skyong chen po nyid kyi zas skal du gnas nas gnyer du gtad pa ji bzhin du las g.yel ba med pa bstan dang de 'dzin gyi 'gal rkyen ci mchis ming gi lhag ma bcil nas mthun rkyenalegs tshogs spel ba'i tha tshig dam bcas kyi dpe bzhin las bzhi'i 'phrin las gang brtsal thams cad ma g.yel ba bsgrabs gnang ba'i bka' drin rjes su dran nas gus spro kun blangs sngar ba rtsal legs pa'i gtang rag mchod sbyin dang / da bcol le /sa pa'i gsol 'debs zhu lan maṅgal dang partsi'i gad rgyang gsal ba ngoms pa'i gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi lha tshes dga' ba dang por sgron dang lha rdzas srid du ring ba tha gru ma nyams pa sna lnga gser mchod 'gur tho lnga/ jus dkar po yug bcas 'bum lam zhus pa zag med bde chen gyi ngang du dgyes dngos/ 'byung 'gyur gyi char yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu der zhing rgyas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sdo rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrab yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba/ khyad par gangs ri rwa bas bskor ba'i nang 'khod pa'i gdul bya'i mgon po rgyal dbang yab sras zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan te mdzad 'phrin mtha' dbus yongs 2 khyab ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams su lo phyugs legs shing / yams 26/

si ri gu ru/ lha sa'i dpon po gnyis bzang bsgrigs mthun po byung bsam lags/ bod so so'i lung pa'i sa mtshams nas so so rang gis bdag po sprad nas phar dgra med pa 'cham po byed rgya byas/ sa si ri mahā rāṅgā sa heb nas dkon mchog dpang por bzharsha pa 'gyur ba med la dwags rgyal po mched gnyis dang / rgyal po bcas la dwags su 'byor bstan drang po drang bzhag gi bzos sgo sngar las lhag pa byed rgyu byas/lha/ par skyabs mgon rtse shod la la dwags nas lo phyag sngon ma nang bzhin lo ltar zhar chag med pa 'bul rgyu/ 'di la si ri mahā rādza sa )ba nas bkag 'gegs mi byed ja dang le na sngon ma nang ltar gtong rgyu/gzhung tshong par la dwags nas rta khul bsgrigs cha sogs dang / la lo phyag gzhung gi mi ser nas rta khal bsgrigs cha byed rgyu bcas dzin tshun nas sngon ma nang bzhin byed rgyu dang la dwags pa nas gzhung sa'i thog la zing shig byed ngan mi byed pa'i bkod pa byed rgyur bla ma dkon mchog dpang bzhag pa dang / si ri ma hā rā dza sa heb dang / lha sa'i bla ma dpon po khang pa gcig lta bu'i nye po byas pa'i bar la dkon mtshag bzhugs yod/ lo stong gcig dang brgyad brgya dgu bcu 'gro ba'i zla ba gnyis pa'i ma sa ra la bzhag pa'i yig dan wa sir gyi the'u lnge mkhan gyi the'u/ la la snyam ma ṇa'i the'u bod dang sing pa'i ngamag don 'khu gcod bgyis/ lugs skor la la dwags sle'i sa gnas su bka' 293

blon tha'i ji zur khang dang dbus mda' dpon spel bzhi/ la hor pa bca'i ska tshab kha chung rgyal po shag sto lam ma/ yin rten gyi mi sna la la bham ma can/ 'dzam bu sa'i sa spyod rā dzā bha ma lab ming gi ngo tshab mbi mkhan ha ri dzan dang / wa sir ra bsnun bcas phan tshun gartsa drag tshang ma ngo 'dzoms thog nas don rtsa bzang bsgrigs 'khrun gcong thag gtsang chos kyi dpyad mtshams ched don ngos bka' mnga' gnyis nas phar sprad kyi 'bru don la lha sa'i dpon po dang mnyam du si ri mahā rā dzā lham ma lab ming dang bzang bsgrigs pa chu stag zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer gsum lha sa'i ska tshab bka' blon zur khang dang / zhib gcod mda' dpon spel bzhig/ si ri rwadzā sa heb kyi mi sna lde mkhan ha ri dzan la )ba/wa sir ra bsnan sa heb bcas mnyam por bsngad de nye po snying nas byas pa yin/ rā bstan byas pa dkon mchog dpang btsugs/ rgyal po gnyis la bzang bsgrigs drang po byas mi ra ri dza sa heb dang / lha sa'i bla ma dpon po gnyis kyi ska tshab sar bzang bsgrigs byung ba yin/yang bskyar bzang bsgrigs kyi sdug cha drang po drang bzhag byas pa sems bzang byas nas bla ma ngarkan mchog dpang por bzhag nas yi ge sprad pa yin/ la dwags gyi sa mtshams snga ma nang ltar lo ltar dang lha sa'i sa mtshams snga ma ltar rang rang gis bdag po byas gcig gis gcig la gnod mi skyel/ ja dang le na gtong rgyu la 'gal min gyis lo snga ma nang 294

ma mchis pa skyabs gnas 'phags mchog mkhas mang 'das pa'i sde rin po che mchog gi zhabs pad dge legs kyi 'dab stong bcu da pa'i khri'i drung du/sgo gsum rab gus dad dam 'gyur ba med pa nas lag pas sor bcu'i 'dab stong spyi bor bkod de phyag dang bcas te zhu gsol 'debs snying / stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi sgo gcig pu rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / gye brag rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dbyangs mi'i rnam rol rje rgyal ba gnyis pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa yab sras rnams kyi lung rigs dpyad pa gsum gyis dag ther le gas par mdzad de thub pa'i dgongs pa ji bzhin gtan la phab pa'i zhwa ser ring lugs dri ma med pa btso sbyong gser gyi yang zhun lta bu'i mdo sngags zung du thel ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyi ma bye ba 'bum las 'phros pa'i sgron me 'di nyid 'jig rten gyi khams su dar rgyas yun ring du gnas pa dang bstan 'dzin mkhas pa yongs kyi dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar gtsug gi rgyan du gyur pa bod 'bangs yongs kyi lha skal rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po sdom brtson ngur theg gar gyi rnam rol gangs can lha gcig skyabs mgon rgyal 297

ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang po mchog dang / rigs kyi cad pan skyabs rje yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang rnam pa gnyis kyi dbus ris med bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dom pa gang na su bzhugs rnams bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs pad rdo rje khams su brtan cing gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongasal khyab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir phan bde'i gzhi rtsa rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba mkhas grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas gangan sa chen po bzhi dang / gsang chen rgyud grwa stong smad gnyis kyis gartsas ris med phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi lde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang ba'i sgo nas bshad sgrab 'chad nyan sogs dbyar gyi mtsho chen ltar 'phel bzhin rgyas te/ba de rnams kyi byin mthur brten yangs ba'i rgyal khams spyi dang / lhag par bod yul bsil ldan sa la'i sman ljongs chos kyi zhing 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod sad ser rtsa than sogs snyigs lnga'i rgud tshogs mtha' dag ming gi zol du gyur nas char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs rtag legs sogs chos sbyor bde skyid zad mi shes pa'i rtag tu 'tsho ba dang / 'jig rten 'di nas gyi ma'i lnga lam du gyur pa (ming smos) la sogs pa'i sems can tshe las 'das tshad rnams //

kya tshe 'khor thog med nas byas bsags jig sgrib bag chags thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ dal rten rim par brgyud pa lam gyi bgrod pa mtharaphyin te zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du thob pa dang / zharabyung du rgya sbyor ba (ming smosaska la sogs pa'i sems can tshe dang ldan tshad rnams kyi gnas skabs mi 'jod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi nas tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang rlung legs tshogs yar rgyas rngas chos mthun bya ba rnams gegs med yid kyi re ltar 'grub pa sogs legs tshogs sgo brgya du ma'i ched du dmigs/ sras bcas rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyan sngar kunabazang mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar 'bum bshams dang 'brel rten gartsa khag la gser chab/ snyan dar/ skyabs gnas 'dus pa rgya mtsho la bsnyenabakur mang ja dang / bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ dbe 'dun re'i phyag tu ska 'gyed sgor gsum re/ spyo 'bul mtshon ched/ phyi lo nas bzung lo ther rten mchog spyan sngar mchod spyin sna lnga brgya tshar 'bul gzhom dang 'brel zhing mchog 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen bkur mang ja gnyis dang /bzhes thug 'bras tsha/ dge 'dun re'i phyag tu ska 'gyed sgor gsum re bcas 'bul lam zhu rgya'i ma thebs sgor sko sko ra bzlo pa dang / skyabs rten rab dkar nang mdzo/ bcas dad gus spro gsum gyi sgo nas 'bul lam zhus po lags na/ gong gsol re 'bras rnams de de bzhin du 'grub ba'i thugs smon skyabs 'jug brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/299
/na bka' drin che byung ba'i ngo ba lanas 'gungs med gtsang 'bu la zhu nas/ zla tshes la phul ba'i rtag

zhig gleng ba la/ thog mar yul dam pa dpal sa skya dang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang mi pa la sogs pa lta bu la/ dpal ldan stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa phyogs bral du gsal bar byed pa'i zla bral chos kyi rgyal po mchog gi zhabs stegs gdong lnga'i dab nga pos mtshan pa'i drung du zhes pa lta bu'am/ yang na/ bska 4 bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i snang bying khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gang de'i zhabs stegs ri dwags rgyal pos mngon par ba tegs pa'i drung du/ zhes sam/ yang na/ lhar bcas skye dga'i skyabs gcig mtshungs zla dbeca pa gang de'i zhabs stegs bsnyengs bral seng gis mtshan pa'i drung du/ zhes sam/ yang na dus gsum shes bya'i dngos kun gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dkyus rnam par yangs pa smra ba'i dbang phyug de'i zhabs kyi skyes dri bral drung du zhes pa lta bu gang rung gi 'bebs kyi zhabs 'og tu/ rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed lus kyi phreng bas btud pa'i phyag ngang chabs cig gsol ba zhes sam rtse gcig ngad pa'i thal sbyar gyis btud de gsol ba zhes sam/ grangs med phyag 'tshal gyi phreng ba bstar bas gsol ba zhes sam/ thal sbyar gyi chu skyes dmar po gtsug tu bkod cing gsol ba zhes pa lta bu'i 'phros nas deng brgya phrag bsod nams kyi byeng po'i mdzub rtses bris pa'i/ dge legs mtshan ris bzang pos nye bar spud pa'i gzugs sku/ mtha' mas gye dgu'i yan 314

cilag mchog gi rgyan du brtan cing / phul byung 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phyin las bzang pos/ bstan 'gro'i dge legs kyi sgo 'phar bye ba phrag brgya cig car 'byed la nam yang g.yo ba ci zhig ces pa tsam dang / bka' shog phebs pa'i lan 'bul lta bu yin na/ snga ma'i 'phros kyi/ nam yang g.yo ba med pa nas/ phyag rgya padma tsā ga'i kha dog la khu bas mtshan pa'i bka' lung rin po che gtsug tu 'byor bas/ don med doga' ba'i rol mchog brgya pas myos ba'i dpe zla rab dga'i sa thob kyi ngo mtshar min pas mtshon du ci zhig 'dir skyabs gsol gdugs dkar gyi grib ma ngal gso pa'ang gsar 'tshes dben par ci bder mchis lags/zhes sam/ yang na/ deng dus dpag yas tshogs bsags dbang phyogs sa 'dzin gyi phrag pa las 'phos pa'i mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i gzugs ska'i rta bdun dbang po/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i mkha' dbyings yangs the dge legs kyi gzi brgya 'bar zhing / rmad byung 'phrin las 'od zer stong gi sa reg 'phral/ phyogs bral 'gro ba'i phan bde'i 'dab stong dga' tshal mtha' dog cig car bzhad pa nas/ dmar mdangs phyag rgya'i 'khor los sgos pa'i bka' lung gi glegs bu'i dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bstsal bas 'chi med yul gyi skal ba bzang po'ang gyi nar bgyid snyam du gyur cing / 'dir skyabs gsol gyi bzlas brjod pa'ang byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdung rtsi'i zegs mas lhung mthus nye zhos dben 315

na/ deng dung gsang gsum mi zad pa'i rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin can gyi gzugs ska'i mi shigs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du grub cing / legs mdzad kyi snang ba cudakar pos mu med phyogs kyi pha mthar bgrod pa nas/bka' tham rin po che byin rlabs rten gyi skyes bcas bstsal ba bka' drin bsam 'das su che/ 'dir skyabs 'og par yang gsar 'tshes dben pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyi zegs ma lhung ba'i byin rlabs nyid du som nyi ci zhig zhes pa lta bu gang 'tshams dang / 'tshams zhu yod tshe 'dir bri/ 'byor lan zhu na/ slad kyi char yang bstan dang lus can yongs kyi dge legs phan bde'i gzhir gyur gzugs sku'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu skye dgu'i legs byas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mir bskal par brtan cing / bdag cag stos bcas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ra ba las mi bor ba'i brdar bka' lung phebs 'os kyang lam gsum 'bab kyi can ltar stsol bar mkhyen/ zhes sam/ yang na/ slad char gangs can phan bde'i rtsa lag zla med gang 'tsham gar gyi gzugs ska'i zla gartson skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi mkha' dkyil brtan cing / bcudag sogs thugs rjes gzigs pas mi g.yel ba'i bka' bstsal bsil ba'i zer gyis/ yid kyi sa mos dga' ba'i 'dab stong bzhad par ci nas mkhyen/ zhes sam/yang na/ slang kyi char bston pa'i snang byed chen po nyid/ deng dus gdul byar gyur pa'i lus can tshogs la rjes su chags pas gsang gsum 3/7

brjod tsam las khyad par med mod/ 'dir yang cung zad dper brjod na/ deng grangs med skye ba'i tshogs zung gi snying po/ ngur sgrig thun mtshams lang tsho'i dpal dang 'grogs pa'i gzugs ska'i snang ba brgya pa/lus med thul gyi dbang po'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brarno pa'i lugs mchog legs bris lam gyi rgyan du mngon par bdo zhing / mkhas tshul dri med phrin las kyi snang ba dam pas phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'gengasu shing /chos dang lus can tshogs kyi dge legs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan phyogs brgyar bzhad pa'i yi ge phyogs kyi bu mo'i sgra 'dzin gyi dpal du 'god par thos tshe/ dga' dang dad pa'i ba spu cir yang g.yo bar gyur zhes/ 'byor lan dgos tshe/ dpal du 'god pa na / bka' ba'i glegs bu phyag rgya 'khor los sgeg pa rten dang bcas pa 'byor bas/ sngon med rab dga'i gar gyis rtsen par gyur cing / 'dir stoms las mkhan gyi 'byung lnga tshogs pa'i spyil bu/ nye zho'i gnyis 'thung dregs pas ma bcom par gnas tshe gang ci'i bgyi 'os mi stod par rtun pa'i khul lags/ zhes sa / yang na/ deng 'char ga'i nyi gzhon snang bas lan brgyar bkra shis pa'i rin chen kāñtsa na'i lhun po gang zhig gdengs can grong khyer chen por brling ba bzhin da/ lhan grub dge mtshan bzang po'i rgyan gyis mngon par sgeg pa'i /gro 'dul rkyel pa'i gar gyi rol pa mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i gzugs sku grangs med gdul bya'i 'khor tshogs dngus 319

su lham mer brjid cing / lung rigs mthun pa'i gsung mchid 'chi ba med pa'i zil dngar gyis/ ying kyi legs bris sngon med dga' ba'i gar gyis rtsen par gyur lags/ zhes sam/ yang na/ deng dus gting mtha' gzhal du med pa'i legs byas kyi dpal las 'khrungs pa'i gang 'dul gar gyi ngur thig rol pa/ phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren sras dang bcas pa'i tshangs dbyang sa 'bum sde gcig tu bsdebs pa'i shis brjod dang chabs cig bgrang yas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur mchog nyid du mnga' gsol nas/ rang gi phrin las zla snang dkar pos phyogs kyi pha rol nyul ba snyam bgyid pa nas/ bka' lung dri za'i 'phang 'gro'i spun zlar byed pa rten dang bcas pa spyi por bstsal 'phral/rab dga'i rten gyi yon tan rgyud la 'khrungs spro 'i dga' bar skyes/bka' 'bangs tha chung yang gsar 'tshes ma bslad par bde bar 'tsho lags/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'tshams zhu yod na 'dir bri/ slad mar yang don gnyis nor bu'i dga' ston 'dzad pa med pa'i 'byung gnas ngur smrig 'chang sku bskal par brtan pa'i cho ga las nam yang mi bskyud pa nas/ bdag sogs stos dang bcas pa thugs brtse med byung don yod kyi zhags pas nam yang mi gtong ba'i snyan ngag dam pa'i rgyud mangs kyi gru yang rim par stsol ba mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes sam/ yang na/ slar yang spyi dang bye brag pa'i bstan pa mi nub pa'i srog zung chen po nyid srid 320

phrin las kyi bsil zer dra ba ring du 'phro ba'i ring nas/ legs gsungs tshangs pa'i bu mo'i rgyad mangs kyi spun zla dang dad rten skyes bzang gi tshogs bcas phebs ༄pa bka' drin bsam yas su che/ 'dir bka'i slob 'bangs tha chung pa'ang 'byung khams stoms shing bgyi bar 'os pa'i rnam g.yeng bar med du bskor ba'i skabs lags/ zhes sam/ yang na/thon sbyangs sa spung dbang po'i steng na gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung don dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'dren byed stong phrag bkra zhing 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i rdo rjes log par sbo ba'i sa 'dzin gyi bgrod byed bcil bar mi g.yel bar bzhugs pa nas/ bka' mchid stan 'jebs kyi phreng ba rten bcas bstsal ba 'byor bas rab dga'i sa thob dga' bder mtshon snyam du gyur/'dir gnas pa'ang rig pa'i bung bas dal rten gyi chu skyes ma bskyud par dge sbyor gyis dbyangs chung dal bur len pa'i skabs lags/ zhes sam/ yang na/ deng skyes sbyangs kyi gzhog rtsal yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhyen dpyod 'dab ldan dbang po'i gyi nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs mu med nam mkha'i mthong yangs bgrod cing / mtsho ldan lus phra dgyes pa'i legs bshad ci 'dod rtag tu 'jo ba'i bka' drin rmad byung du che/'byor lan yin na sngar dang 'dra/ 'dir gsung gi bdud rtsi las skyes pa'i gyi na ba'ang dus 'dzin 'thor byed kyi dri gzhan du 'phyan skabs/dal rten gyi khang bu brling ba'i skabs zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'tshams zhu 322

na phul byung stobs kyi 'khor los chab srid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la mnga' sgyur ba'i chos ldan sa 'dzin dbang po gang de'i zhabs stegs drung du/ zhes pa lta bu'i zhabs kyi 'bebs 'og tu gus pas rgya ba/deng rjon bsags dpag yas zla ba'i ma ma las 'thon pa'i gzugs sku'i 'dod 'byung dbang gi rgyal po chos dang srid pa'i gtsug lag lhab lhub brtsegs pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor spud tshe/ rmad byung byams brtses kun nas bslangs pa'i legs mdzad 'dod dgu'i dga' ston gyi gtong ba 'dzad pa med pa'i char gyis/ bstan dang lus can yongs kyi mi mthun rgad pa mtha' dag ring du bcil nas/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten khams rkyen bde legs rdzogs ldan gzhon nu ci yang 'gugs pa'i rnga mtshar snyan dngags mkhas dbang bye bas brjod kyang mthar gtugs bzod pa ci zhiga'abyor lan yin na ji ma'i 'phros kyi mthas gtugs da na pa'i ri nang bzhugs pa nas/ pad ma rwa ga'i zhun ma'i tshon gyis sgog pa'i bka' rtags phyag rgyas btab pa'i bka' lung gi glegs bu gtsug tu 'byor bas yid kyi khye'u chung sngon med kun dga' ba'i rol ci yang rtsen par gyur lags zhes bsgyur/ yang na/ 'dir byams brtse'i gdags dkar gyi grib mar ngal gso ba'ang gsar 'tshes dben par dge sbyor la rtun pa'i khul gyi gnas tshul lags/ zhes sam/ yang na/ deng dus rgyal phran bdud rtsi'i zas can yongs kyi yan lag mchog tu pas/ stegs bgyid 324

la bsnyengs pa med par/ gtsug lag grangs med gzigs pa'i khyen dargyad kyi 'dren byed stong phrag bgrad cing chab srid phun tshogs mtho ris kyi dpal kun rtsen la gzhar yang bsdo bas dben pa'i 'phrin yig gling bu phyogs bral srid pa'i sgra 'dzin du 'jebs pa'i rnga mtshar la rjes su yi rang / 'dir dpal ldan nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs kyi rjes su slob 'dun ma bor tsam gyis dge sbyong pa'ang nye nas dben par ji 'khor gnas/ zhes sam/ yang na/ sngon bsags bsod nams ga ra gyi sgo nga'i sbugs las skyes pa'i sa skyong gser mngal can bstan jus mtho ris yul gyi dpal kun rang dbang bgyid la bsnyengs pa dang bral zhing tshad med rnam bzhi'i lam gyi gdong mdzes bzhi las/ 'jig rten dge legs gsar pa'i rig byed 'byin pa'i mes po nyid du bzhugs pa spa mkhas yongs kyis bskal pa snyan dngags kyi phreng bas bsngags pa'i 'os su che'o 'dir chos mthun khrims kyis sa steng skyong ba gang gi byams brtse'i ra bar 'khod pa'i mu to ba yang bag phab ci bder rtsen la nyer 'tshe med par chos ldan sa dbang nyid kyi ska drin du 'khum lags zhes pa lta bu gang 'tshams sbyor/ 'tshams zhurā yod na 'dir 'bri/ slad char bstan srid yongs kyi dzin bde'i phun tshogs dbyar gyi dpal mo 'gugs pa'i rtsa lag sa dbang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rin chen ri'i dbang po bzhin du mi shigs bskal brgyar 'tsha gzhes su byed pa'i 325

byas pa dbang chen po gang de'i drung du'am zhabs drung du gang 'tsham gus gsol lam/ zhu ba'am ched zhus/ / bkar dge tshogs dbyar gyi dpal mo'i rgyad las 'phos pa'i phun tshogs dal 'byor rten gyi rkang 'thung dbang pocu/ rnam par dpyod pa'i me tog 'bum phrag 'dzum zhing dge bcu'i bka' khrims kyi yal ga gzhin nu phyogs bral brkyang pa'i grib bsil du lus can yongs kyi ngal 'tsho'i gsos sman du gyur par rjes su yi rang / 'dir gnas pa'i stoms las pa 'ang 'byung tshogs kyi rdzing bu rnam shes ngang pa'i bu mos ma bor bar lhag bsam dbe blo ma bskyud tsam du thonas zhes pa lta bu'am yang na/ deng legs byas rdul dkar gyi phre nga ba brtsegs pa'i byams ldan sa 'dzin gangs ldan lhan po mkhyen dpyod zung gi nyi zla'i snang bas 'khyud cing / dge rtsed bsil ba'i rgyun gyis 'gro ba'i mi mthun gdung ba 'phrog pa'i dpal du brtan pa nas/ gsung mchid rten dang bcas 'byor pa spro ba mchog tu brtas shing / 'dir yang dge sbyor rgan bu gsar 'tshes dben pa'i gnas tshul lags/ zhes pa lta bu' / de rnams la 'byor lan zhu na/ slad kyi char yang rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i dal 'byor ska'i rkang 'thung dbang po dge spyod dbyar skyes kyi khrod du brtan pa'i rirā nas gsung mchid phebs 'os phreng ba'ang gaṅgā'i rgyun gyi rjes 'gror 'bebs 'tshal/zhes me lha bu brjod don dang mthun pa gang 'os bsgre'o//327

skye sbyangs kyi lta byed rnam par yangs shing / ngo mtshar legs bshad kyi snang bar byed pa'i dga' ston 'dzad pa med pa'i 'byung gnas su bzhugs pa nas gsung mchid zhib bstsal phebs pa/ yid kyi gsos su smin/'dir gnas pa'ang dal rten bde bar 'tsho zhing rnam dkar bgyi 'os kyi las lam snga mkho bzhin brtson pa'i gnas tshul lags/ zhes sogs skabs su gang bab dang / 'byor lan ngagos tshul gong ma rnams kyi rigs 'gre dpyad shes par bya'o/ /zhes pas mtshon te bsngags yul gyi yon tan dang rjes su mthun par brjod pa las/ thams cad kyi dper brjod pa ni blo ldan phur bu yin yang brjod kyis mi longs ba nyid do/ /smras pa/dag byed gter nas sgod kyi chu gtsang bar/ /bsil sbyin dbang po gcig las grangs med gzugs/ /'phrul ltar mchog 'bring yul gyi yon tan la/ cung zad bsngags pa'i 'phrin yig 'bul ba'i tshul/ /srid zhi'i brjod bya mtsho ldan dgyes pa'i grur/ /song ba'i legs bshad 'chad la dge ba'i dbang / /rnam 'dren bstan pa'i nyi shar kha ba'i ljongs/ /sgyug 'dzin mchu snang gzhon nu'i rnam par brgyas/ /'di bgyis dge bas yang srid stozlos bcu pa'i /yon tan mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /sgra don rgyan gyi lam nas 'dren pa la/ /bsnyengs bral smri ba'i dbang phyug nyid gyur cig /ces bsngags thos mchog 'bring gi yul rnams la zhu yig 'bul ba'i ngaper brjod blo gros gsar bus 'jug sgo zhes 330

paṇa chen mchog gi sprul ska rin po che 'gro ba'i 'dren pa 'khon ston bdag chen chos kyi rje gong 'og hūṃ gzigs mi'i dbang po bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon chab mdo 'phags pa lha/ gdan sa chen po'i rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri rin po che gdan zur/ rje btsun dem pa khal kha 'jam dbyangs zhabs drung / sgam 'brug sprul pa'i sku/ zhwa dmar naga'abri stag mtshur bu drung pa sogs bka' brgyud bstan pa'i gsal byed kyi sprul skas mtshon yongs grags kyi bla chen/ ba so rje drung / rdo rje brag rshanas rnying / de mo/ sbyor ra/ stong 'khor/ byams pa/ brag yags/ lcags zam/ bsam sdings pa rnams kyi sprul sku/gsang phu gling stong smad/ skyid shod dang rgya ri'i zhabs drung chos rje/hor tshang gis mtshon pa'i chos rje che khag zha lu dang tshogs sde bzhi'i mkhan chen/ sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal khang rtse pa/ rgyal sras sprul sku/ chab mdo rje drung / gsung sprul thugs sras nyi sde/ dpa' bo bcas pa'i pal ska/ ras chung phug dang / bde chos/ sdings po che sogs kyithe mthen sprul ska che 'bring / chos 'khor rgyal/ dga' ldan shar byang / co nee/ga bya khyung bcas pa'i chos rje dang / rwa sgreng /rdzing snyi/ sde drug lnga mchod/ ri bo bde chen/ spyan g.yas/skyor lung / byams gling / dpal 'khor chos sde/ ngoms rings/ngor snar thang lhun rtse/ skyed tshal gong 'og 'phags sde bzhi/ mnga' 332

ris khri rtse/ khams li thang sogs kyis mtshon mkhan po'i rigs/ brtsa brgyad/ gnas gsar/ lcags zam dbon bcas kyi chos rje dang /gter bdag gling dzi/ spos dga'/ dung dkar/ che chen chos rje/dpal ri bas mtshon pa'i mkhan slob chos rje che ge mo'i ska skye'i rigs/se 'bras dge gsum gyi gartsas skyos sde grwa tshang che 'bring rsha slob dpon zhal snga yi rigs/ skyabs mgon gong sa mchog gi mchod dpon gzim dpon bcas nye 'khor 'phags pa'i mchog dam pa/ byang phyogs dpon khag gi ti zer bkur ba'i chos rje dkyus ma'i rigs dgon sde chu'i bla ma dang ska skye'i rigs/ gsang 'ug sa cog skra bzang / brag sna/ sgrolag ma/ bsam yas dkar po bas mtshon pa'i chos rje'i rigs/gzhan yang dar sdings/ zhang ston/ shel brag pas mtshon sngags bon gdung 'dzin gyi rigs/ 'dus tshogs kyi dbu chos/ rab tu byung ba sogs dge 'dun mdor na ser gzugs sngags bon lha sder gtogs pa mtha' dag go/gnyis pa drung zhu'i brjo sgo dang 'bebs ni/ dpal gnam pa'i dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug gong ma mi dbang chen po/ sa'i tshang pa chen po bstan 'dzin ḍho las khang / sa la spyod pa'i brgya byin dga' ldan ba na 'dzin po shog thu rgyal po/ stobs kyi dbang phyug she ye thu rdo rje rgyal po/ nor 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba char ti ni dha las hong 333

'i ji/ dza sag thug khang gis mtshon pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal rigs/ de 'og byang phyogs khal kha i zad kyi rgyal po'i gdung dang rigs chos kyis mngon par mtho ba'i dpon khag gong sa mchog nas che 'don dang lung las kyi tham ka sogs bstsal ba'i dpon po che kha'i rigs dang / bod du rgya ri ba/ skyid skad mi rje khag gsum/ bya nag rigs kyi thig le/ 'brog khri dpon khag gor re lha pas mtshon pa'i sde dpon che khag sal kha cha rod kyi rigs chos kyis mtho ba'i gong nas che 'don dang cho lo tham ga sogs bstsal ba'i dpon po 'bring po'i rigs dang / smo mdo'i nang sogs khag lnga/ bod du bzhed rtsas mtshon dpon po 'bring bar gtogs pa/ byang phyogs bstan skyong gi cho rigs btsun pa'i dpon khag rigs dang / bon du thon pa/ shag stos mtshon pa'i sde dpon chung khag bla chen rga rim ltar gyi phyag mdzod/ 'bog rgong mdar gdong / bying snam/ sbrum lcags/ zad 'brong / spyan rdzong /dpal de/ kong po dpon khag gis mtshon nang snam che khag rgyal khab chen po'i mdun na 'don dang / nang snam dkyus ma sprul ska che 'bring gi dbon phyag mdzod/ grwa tshang chos sde che khag gi gnyer sezlo mo ba dang /drung 'khor drag 'bring dkyus gsum/ sding dpon/ rtags 'du/brgya dpon/ nang ga na drag zhan/ rgan bcu dmangs sogs srid sde'i rigs mtha' dag go/334

gnyis pa/ drung zhu dang 'bebs bzos ngangos la chos srid kyi bajig pa so sor yod mod kyang / drung zhu dang 'bebs bzos mtho dman go rim byed lugs khyad med rim bzhin sbyor du rung ba'i rim pa nang gses bcu las/ dang po ni/ 'bul yul mtshathe don gyi bsngags pa rgyas babs gang rung ba'i mthar/ zhabs stegs mutpal rnam par ba da pa mchog rsha drung du/ drung zhu'i 'bebs mtho gang tsam nas/ sgo gsum gus pas sor bcu spyi bor bkod de zhu ba/ phyogs der gdong phyogs thos bsregs thal mo sbyar te zhu ba dang / yang na gus pa chen pos phyag dang bcas te zhu ba 'og tu chud nges/ gnyis pa 'bul yul gyi bsngags brjod mtshan smos kyi mthar zhabs drung du 'bebs sor bcu tsam nas/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te zhu ba'am/ gus pa chen pos zhu ba zhes gang rung sbyar ba'i brjod chig snyan 'jebs rgyas brdzas tsam las gong dang cha 'dra tsam/ gsum pa/ bsngags brjod rimatshan smos ji ltar brjod pa'i mthar/ zhabs drung du/ 'bebs sor brgyad nas zhu ba 'og tu chud pa byed/ bzhi pa mtshan gyi bajigs pa gang brjod kyi mthar drung du/ 'bebs sor drug bzhag pa'i thad 'brangs nas cu ba 'god/ lnga pa mtshan smos bsngags pa'i mthar rin po cher/ 'bebs sor lnga pa nas zhu bar 'og tu chud pa 'bri/ drug pa dngos ming bsngags pa gang yang ma byas par/ lags zhes smos ngos 'bebs sor gsum 335

gseg 'gros nas/ ched 'bul lta bu/ bdun pa dngos ming snyan 'jebs kyi mthar phyag tu/ zhes pa'i mig mjug skyur/ 'og ma'i phreng thog gsegs 'gros che tsam nas phul don lta bu dang brjod mdzod sbyar ba las thad bris byings dkyus 'gre/ brgyad par dngos ming la zhe sa cung zad btags pa'i ska 'tsho bde ba sogs kyi bka' mi bcag gi thad bris dgu par daces ming la zhe sa phran bu mdzad/ bcu par thad bris ming smos kyi dkyus 'gre byed pa dman pa la'o/ /de'ang chos rgyal mes dbon rnams kyi dus shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan dang / mthar dge ba bsngo ba'i rten 'byung ngam smon pa sogs snyan tshig gi gzhung ltar las 'bebs dang drung zhu sogs med 'dra zhing / sne'u gdong pa'i dus su snyan drung dang ska drung sogs mdzad srol gyi rgyun deng sang yang yod pa ni drung du zhes dro'i khongs su 'thus par sems tshu//yang gtsang lugs la ming dang bsngags brjod gang yang med par drung zhes brjod pa ni che khyad kyi bkur bzos bla med yin zhes myu ba khungs dang mi 'brel ba'i stabs bde yin tshul kho bo'i bla ma rnam zas gling pa ma hā pa ta'i gsung la nges so//gsum pa 'phrin lan ming smos kyi go rim la yang bcu las/ dang po gnyis pa 'dra bar bka' shog rin po che yan lag mchog gi rtse mor phebs zhes pa'am/ sbya bor phebs pa'i bka' drin che tshul sogs brjod/336

gsum par bka' tho rin po che phebs tshul/ bzhi par bka' tham rin po che phebs tshul/ lnga par gsung shog phebs tshul/ drug par gsung bris phebs tshul/ bdun par phyag bris rten ldan 'byor bas legs tshul/brgyad par ri mo mdzad pa 'byor pas legs tshogs che tshul/ dgu par ming thog tu zhe sa phran bu sbyar ba'i yi ge mdzad pa 'byor bas legs tshul/bcu par yi ge rten ldan 'byor tshul brjod/ de'ang bla ma'i rigs la thugs dam rin po che phebs zhes brjod pa yang sngar gyi chab shog la snang rnga / /gzhan yang chen po'i rigs la bka'i glegs bu dang chab zhogabar pa'i rigs la phyag dam sogs brjod pa yang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su mkhas pas gsungs so/ /de yang gong gi sa bcad drug pa yan gyi rten tshur byung la gnang skyes gnang rten sogs gang rung phebs tshul brjod pa'i bka' drin che tshul dang / bdun pa nas rten ldan 'byor bas legs tshul brjod pa 'og gi dper brjod kyang gsal lo//bzhi pa mjug bsdoms kyi zhu mchid sbyor tshul la yang gong dang bstan pa'i rim pa bcu las/ dang po dang gnyis pa 'dra bar/ slad nadro thugs rjes 'dzin tshul brjod pa'i mthar bka' bstsal slob ston gyi rim stsol mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'debs mtshon tsam gyis btegs te tshes gsham la rang gi ming smos pa 'di dang 'dis phul ba'i zhu yig ces zhu yig 'og tu 'bebs/ de yang tshes gsham dang kha yig tu rang gi 337

dngos ming mi rgyag pa ni 'bul yul gnyan pa'i che ba bkur bzos bla med yin zhes mkhas pa rnams gyis bzhed do/ /gsum par slad nas rgyabs yul la byams brtse'i gzigs pa nas mi 'dor tshul brjod 'os bka' mchid slob ston gyi tshogs rim yod mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'degs byed tsam la rgya zhus/ tshes la 'bul ba'i zhu yi ga 'bebs/ bzhi par dgongs khyim nas mi 'dor tshul brjod ngos/ phebs 'os slob ston gyi tshogs rim yong pa mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'degs rten tsam la rgya ldan bcas tshes la phul ba'i zhu yig ces zhu yig 'chabs phab tsam/ lnga par thugs nye 'ardor med kyi phebs tshogs rim yod zhu zhu/ zhes dang rgya zhus med pa'i zhu tho rten dang bcas/ tshes la 'bul ba'i zhu tho/zhes zhu tho phab tsam/ drug par gsung 'os rim yod 'tshal/ rten dang bcas zhes phul phab tsam/ bdun par rim mol mchid rim yod 'tshal/rten dang bcas tshes la phul/ zhes phul thad bris brgyang pa dang dgu pa 'dra bar/ 'phros 'os rim yod mdzod/ rten dang bcas tshes la zhes pa las phul sogs mi sbyor/ bcu par bsrings 'os rim yod gyis/ rten dang bcas tshes la/ zhes thad bris byings 'gro/de yang drung zhu yod rigs la bka' 'doms sogs kyang gang thad sbyar tu rung // lnga pa kha yig dang nyung la'i sdoms gnyis las/ dang po ni hung 338

la'i mdurna yig tu so so'i bsngags brjod mtshan rgyas bsngas sogs nang du mtshan smos gang bkod pa bris ngos gong gi sa bcad darā bstan pa'i rim pa bcu las/ dang po gnyis pa gsum pa rnams 'dra ༄bar mdun yig gi zhabs pang drung du zhes ba/nga rung yod pa'i 'og du phul chug pa 'bebs/ rgyab yig la rang gi ming dngos bris nas 'di lta bu'i zhu yigaces zhu yig 'og phab nas 'god bzhi par mdun yig gi drung du'i 'og thad du bul phab pa/ rgyab yig la dngos ming med pa'i rang gnas gang yin nas zhu yig ces zhu yig 'bebs/ lnga par mdun yig rin po che zer ba'i 'og tu ma chug pa'i gsegs 'gros kyi phul phab pa/ rgyab yig la rang gnas khang gang yin nas zhu tho phab tsam byed drug par mdun yig tu bsngags brjod chos kyi rjer phul/ mkhyen pa'i ngabang por phul/ zhes pa lta bu'i 'bul yul dang bstan pa'i mtshan gyi mtha'i phul gsegs 'gros su phul phab tsam dang / ༄ rgyab yig la ra gnas gang yin nas/ zhes pa las zhu tho mi sbyor bdun par bskur yul gyi ming smos bsngags brjod gang yin gyi mthar phyag tu/ phul zhes pa dang / gsegs 'gros che ba'i phul phab tsam dang / rgyab yig med/ rgyab yig med cing / mdun yig la bsngags brjod ming smos rgyas bsdus gang bkod pa'i mthar phul thad bris/ dgu par zhe sa ming sngon du smos tsam byas pa'i bskur yul/ dge slong rab 'byams/339

bka' bcu/ dpon po/ chos mdzang/ dge bshes sogs dang /de bzhin du sde pa/ zhal ngo / nang po/ zas po lta bu'i skabs thob ming gi zhe sa zur tsam sbyar ba'i la yig kho na'o/ /bcu par thad bris ming smos kyi kha yig byings 'gre/ de yang kha yig la drung du yod pa'i rgyab yig la zhu tho sbyor ba dang / nang gsham du zhu zhu 'god pa dang / nang du 'bebs bzos yod pa 'ga' zhig la rgyab yig med gnang zhing / nang thams cad gnang ba sogs gong sa yas phyin gyi bka' zhog tu bstsal ba 'ga' zhig gnang bkag gi rgya mtshan bshad du rung ba yod la/ gzhan ma mtha' dag gi dpe byarab mi 'os pas mtho dman go rim dang bstan drung zhu'i brjos sgo sa bcad bcu po mchog dman bar gsum du bstan pa bzhin mgo mjug tshang tsam dgos par bstan sgo/ /gzhan yang 'bul yul gnyan par zhu yig rgyab yig dngos ming gi thog tu zhabs pad rin po cher zer ba bkod pa ni bkur bzos dpal thal las 'brel khungs med tshul chos blon chen po rtag tu nas kyi gsung las thos so/ /gnyis pa hung la'i rgya ldems la gong sa mchog gi bka' shog rin po che'i rgya ldems nyis ltab zhog thag mdun yig gi mgo thog tu ltag zer/ zhal dam zhal ris kyi yig mgo hung la'i mdun ltag phyogs su yi ge'i 'gros bzhin dang / rgyab zur slog gi 'bebs shing zhal byang ming mthar sprod pa dang / nang du yig mgo sgor mo bris steng 'bar sgo/ nang yig 340

tho 'byor tho don lta bu/ tshes gsham du bris zhes pa dang / gsham shog 'jog che ba sogs gnang srol yod pa ni gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang mchog gi bka' shog rin po che kho na ma gtogs/ srid pa gsum na lha mi thams cad khengs pa dor nas phyag bya ba'i yul gcig tu gyur pas stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams su mtshungar pa dang bral ba yin zhing / gzhan ma rgya ldems lhag gzer dang gsham shog 'jog pa ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal rigs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskar ba'i mi bdag dang / yongs grags kyi bla chen rgyal rigs/ cu dpon chen ma gtogs de phyin gyi 'bul bskar gang la'ang yang gsham zhog dang ltag gzer sogs mi 'os la/ de ༄yang sa bcad gong gi 'gros 'bul yul dang po la bzhi ltab tsam/ gnyis par phyed bzhi ltab/ gsum par gsum stob rtse khug bzhi par gsum stob kher rkyang / lnga par gsum ltab ma lor tsam/ drug pa gyed gsum lhab/ bdun pa man nas nyis ltab rtse bkug tsam gyi ltab kha byed/ the'u rnams gang du'ang skag bu'i 'gugs pa'i phyogaso su the'u'i mgo gtad nas rgyag the'u'i go rim dang brda chad sogs legs bshad nor bu'i 'dren pa'i gru gzings su gsal la bka' nag la bka' tham/ bka' bstsal la bka' mchid/ gsung shog la gsung bris sogs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs las brjod byar mtho dman mi 'dra rung / gyis rna bar 'jebs ma 'jebs kyi sgra 'jam rtsub la blta phyogs 341

su 'khyer ba'i go rim mtho dman du byed pa da lha'i mkhas pa rnams kyi lugs srol du bzhed pa ltar dper brjod dang sa bcad go bder bstan pa yin no//drug pa dper brjod ni/ de yang 'bul ba po rang nyid gong gi rigs mthun dbye ba'i go rim gang yin gyi gras su gtogs pa nas brtsi zhing mchog dman kun la snyan tshig cung zad sbyar te ha cang rgyas pa ma yin pa'i go bde'i dper brjod so sor bstan pa la chos srid gnyis las/dang po ni/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog nas rim pa bzhin sa ba cad gong gi 'gros ltar nang gses bcu las/ dang po ni/ lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug rgyan dam pa rin po che'i zhabs stegs utpal rnam par bzhad pa mchog gi drung du/ sgo gsum gus pas sor bcu spyi bor bkod de zhu ba/ deng gi dus sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i nus pa'i rang gzugs ma lus pa gcig tu gyur pa'i mtshan pa'i snang brnyan rdo rje gsum gyi rin chen snang mi'i skye dgu mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan nor bu'i do skar gyis btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon po nas nam yang g.yo ba med par 'tsha zhing gzhes pa dang lhan cig bka' zhog rin po che gnang skyes bzang po bcas bstsal pa spyi bor phebs pas sa gsum yid can gyi spyi dpal du gyur pas slar yang lag pas snying gar zum/ rang gi gnas tshul med kyang chog la/ byed na'ang zur tsam las mi byed pa ni 342

'bul yul gnyan pas mi spobs/ mtshams kyi zhu mchid/ don gnyer sogs yod na 'di mtshams su 'god/ slad nas ris med bstan 'gro'i dpyid dpal du zhabs zung 'khor lo'i rang gzugs bskal brgyar brtan cing / yid can spyi dang bye brag la byang chub bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa chen po nas mi 'dor ngos bka' stsol slob ston skal ldan shing rta'i bgrod pa ltar mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'degs mtshon tsam du lha rdzas maṅga'i rtags can gyisabategs te yar tshes la blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas kyis phul ba'i zhu yig ces pa lta bu'i rang nyid 'bul ba po'i dngos ming rgyag pas mtshon zhu yig 'bebs/ kha yig rgyab ldems 'bebs bzos shin tu che ba'i sa bcad dang po ltar ro/ /gzhan yang spros bcas kyi rgyas pa byed na bzlo'i gzhung la sbyong pa bskyed nas bcad lhag spel ma sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi ska gsung thugs yon tan//phrin las sogs nas ba sngags pa brjod na nādi phyi'i legs byas kyi tshogs 'phel ba yin te/ mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan dngags mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs gyis bstong nas kyang / /dang po byang chub ta ni sems bskyed do/ /zhes dang / chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen rā nas/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni /de nyid yin gyir mkhas pa yis/ /'di la sangs 343

rgyas rjes dran byos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang bu mo mu tig 'khri shing / dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu sogs kyang 'phrin gyi sgo nas bden pa thob nas mtshon dad mos gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa dang lhan cig brjod de phul na ngag gi sdig sgrib 'dag par ma zad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang du gyur pa sogs bka' bstan du mar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni lhar bcas skye dgu'i 'dren pa chen po'i zhabs pad dam pa rin po che'i drung du/ sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag byas te zhu ba/ deng dus gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo can bsnyengs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang las g.yo ba med cing / mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'od stong 'phro bas 'gro ba kun gyi cod pan du 'bar bzhin pa nas bka' shog rin po che gnang skyes dang bcas bstsal ba spyi bor phebs pas bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag tu mtshungs zla ci/ 'dir phran bu yang gang gi thugs rje'i grib bsil las lnga lam du ma gyur tsam du gnas lags/ mtshams zhu/ don 'god pa sogs 'di mtshams su bya/ slad nas rnam par kun tu ye shes kyi skyabs yul nas 'dor med ngos bka' stol slob ston gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'degs rten gong dang cha 'dra tsam mi rung snying nas skyon med do/ /'phags chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa dang spangs rtogs mi mnyam tsam ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi lha 344

mthu bo ches btud cing nyan rang gi ba na pa mi nus pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan gyi thug rje mchog tu mnga' bas na de tshul sbyor du rung zhes legs bshad la'ang gsal lo/ gsum pa ni mtshungs med skyabs mgon dam pa rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ deng dus mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan rdo rje'i khri 'phang mthon po las g.yo ba med cing /ris bral gyi gdul bya ma lus pa thar pa chen po'i lam bzang du 'god bzhin pa nas thugs dam rin po che gnang rten bcas spyi bor phebs pas bka' drin mtshungs med du gyur/ 'dir phran bu yang gong gi skyabs rol las bde bar 'tsho lags/ mtshams zhu sogs bya/ slad chad thugs rje dang ye shes kyi gzigs pa chen pos nam yang 'dor ba med ngos bka' stsol slob ston mtho ris klung ltar mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'dogs rten gong dang cha 'dra zhing / 'bebs sa bcas gsum pa nas len/gzhan yang / skyabs gnas dam pa chos kyi rje zhal snga nas rin chen zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ deng gi dus sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin mchog tu brtan cing skye 'gro smin grol gyi lam bzang por 'god pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi phrin las yar ngo'i zla zhal ltar 'phel ba'i ngang nas bka' thams cad rin chen gnang rten dang bcas nyams med phebs pas bka' drin bla lhag tu che/ 'dir phran chung yang 'byung ba cha stoms shing dam pa'i rnam thar yid la 'dor med kyi khul du gnas lags/345

mtshams zhu/ don gnyer sogs bya slad du'ang thugs ngam skyabs yul rdo rje'i ra ba nas mi 'dor ngos bka' mchid slob ston gyi tshogs shing rta'i bgrong pa ltar mkhyen lags/ zhes sogs gong 'dra/ de yang chos sde grwa tshang khag gi slob dpon zhal snga nas rigs la gong bzhin dang /mkhan po'i rigs la rdo rje 'chang mkhan rin po che dang / chos dre 'i rigs la mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ sngags rigs la rig 'dzin dam pa sogs bya/ spyi po'i rigs la chos sde chen po spyi bo rin po che sogs brjod cing / de dag skyabs yul kho na yin pas skyabs gnas dam pa zhes mgor sbyar dgos te/ mdo sde myang 'das las dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song na/ 'jigs pa med par thon par 'gyur/ zhes dang / gzhan yang rang gi bka' drin gsum tre ci tsha rtsa ba'i bla ma slob dpon dang / nge lta min pa'i mkhas grub kyi dam ku phyag bya 'os pa sogs rang gi dbang khrid 'u nga gsum zhus pa'i ngam pa la sangs rgyas dngos gyi 'du shes dang bsngags pa brjod rigs/ 'jam mgon rtsang kha pa chen pos 'jig rten dang 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge gshegs kyi/ yon tan kun gyi drin len rje/ /yid la dran pa tsam gyis dus kun tu/ /mos gus rtsol med skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs shing / /gzhan yang / bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam zhes dang / bskal pa byustong gi sangs rgyas de/ zhes sogs gsungs pas bsngags brjod bla med bya'o/ /0 346

bzhi pa ni mdo rgyud kun la thogs med sbo ba'i 'byung gnas dam pa rin po che'i drung du zhu ba/ deng dus ska rin po che nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal zhing / chorsha phung brgyad khri'i legs bshad kyi 'od snang du 'bar bas thub bstan utpala'i tshal kun 'bum phrag tu bzhad pa'i ngang nas bka' thog rin po che gnang rten dang bcas phebs pas bka' drin gyi dpal du gyur/ 'dir yang 'du ba stoms ldan khul du mchis lags/ mtshams zhu sogs bya/ slad char legs par bshad pa'i zab chos kyi slob ston phebs 'os 'bab ldan rgyun bzhin mkhyen lags/zhu yig rten tsam la rgya ldan bcas tshe la phul ba'i zhu yig ces zhu yig 'bobs/ lnga pa ni gnas rten 'dul ba 'dzin pa bstan pa'i gsal byed rin po cher/ zhu ba/ deng yang tshogs gnyis kyi chu gter las thongs pa'i ska'i zla zhal lhag par gsal zhing / thos bsam lung rigs gyi 'od brgya cu'abar bzhin pa nas gsung zhog rten gnang bcas phebs pa bka' drin che/ 'dir yang lus 'tsho bde ldan du gnas lags/ don sogs bya/ slad nas thugs nyid rdo rje pha lam gyi dra ba chad med ngos phebs 'os paklu'i klung bzhin zhu/ zhu tho rten dang bcas/ tshes la 'bul ba'i zha tho/ zhes zhu tho phab tsam/ drug pa ni lags ched 'bul/deng yang darsha legs rgya mche'i mngal khur las bltams pa'i sku 'tsho de wa da ru'i ljon pa mchog tu rgyas shing / zhi lhag ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras 347

bu g.yur du za ba nas gsung bris rten gnang bcas phebs pas spro/'dir ngos kyang 'du phung dus 'dzin rkyen gyi ma reg tsam du gnas/ slad nas nyer len gyi 'phrod bzhes gseng med nas snying po'i don gyi gsung 'os rim yod 'tshal/ rten lha rdzas bcas tshes la 'bul/ zhes phul phab tsam/ bdun pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po'i phyag tu/ phul don/ deng yang sku 'tsho gnyis 'thung dbang po'i lus stobs lhag par rgyas zhing / tshul khrims bslab gsum gyi myos bum gzengs su mtho ba nas/ phyag bris rten ldan 'byor bas yid kyi gsos su gyur/ 'dir yang 'tshe ba med ngos thos bsam 'jug pa dman khul du mchis/ slad nas dge ba'i mol mchid rim yod 'tshal/ rten dang bcas tshes la phul/zhes phul thad bris/ brgyad pa ni bka' bcu shes rab 'od zer legs byas ska 'tsho'i chu skyes mchog tu rgyas zhing / mdzad bzang 'dab brgya'i phreng dro phang phung du dgod bzhin pa nas ri mo rten ldan 'byor pas legs tshogs che/ 'di na'ang 'du ba'i 'phel 'khrug cha stoms nas chos 'os ldan gyi bgyi ba stod med khul du gnas/ slad char ring min gyi 'phrin rim yod mdzad do/ /rten dang bcas tshes la/ zhes pa lta bu/ dgu pa ni chos rje legs pa rgyal mtshan deng 'tsho ba ko bai dha ra'i ljon pa ltar lhun chags shing / khyab cha yar ldan nas ye shes rten ldan 'byor pas legs shing spro/ 'di na'ang 'tsho ba bde zhing bgyi 'os mi dman par 348

deng gi dus dge legs chu gter chen po'i 'jings zab las bskrun pa'i ska rin chen bcu drug cha ldan gyi ngor ri la rgol ngan dal 'bab 'dzin thes rgyang bzings shing / lugs zung mkhyen pa'i 'od brgya 'bar bzhin pa ni bka' drin lhag par che/ phran bu'ang mchog gsum dam pa'i thugs rjes 'tshe ba ma mchis tsam du gnas lags/ mtshams zhus bya/ slad nas dgongs khyim dam pa mchog nas mi 'dor ngos/ bka' gnang slob ston tshangs pa'i ral klung ltar mkhyen lags/ zhu meg 'degs byed tsam la rgya zhus tshes la phul ba'i zhu yig ces zhu yig 'bebs/ bzhi pa ni/ sde pa rin po che mkhyen ldan mchog gi zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/deng gi dus tshogs gnyis 'o mtsha gsar pa'i mdzes sku stog pa dang bral zhing / gtsug lags bye ba'i rlabs phreng phyogs dus kun tu g.yo bzhin par bzhugs pa'i snyan pa thos 'dzin gyi bdud rtsir gyur pas bka' drin mchog tu che/ 'dir phran bu yang lus kyi chu skyes dang snang sems kyi bung ba ma bral tsam du gnas lags/ mtshams zhu/ slad char dgongs khyim nas 'dor med ngos phebs 'os slob ston dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'dogs rten tsam la rgya ldan bcas tshes la phul ba'i tho yig ces zhu yig 'bebs/ lnga pa ni mchog rin po che/'a bcu/ deng ska 'tsha gnyis 'thung gi dbang po lhag par rgyas shing /byeng stobs 'phongashā rkyen gyi sna zhags ring pos phyogs gzhan zil gyis 351

gnon bzhin pa'i grags snyan thos pas bka' drin che/ 'dir yang gsar 'tshes med pa'i stoms ldan khul du gnas lags/ mtshams su zhu gsol/slad char thugs nye 'dor med nas phebs tshogs kyang sgri ta'i 'gros bzhin zhu zhu/ zhu tho rten dang bcas tshes la phul ba'i zhu tho/ zhes lhu tho phabamatsam/ drug pa ni lags ched 'bul/ deng legs byas ska 'tsha'i ri dbang mchog tu brtan cing / lus zung dastod ldan gyi ba sgom bkra ba ni bka' drin che 'dir yang 'du ba stoms ldan khul du gnas/slad char gsung 'os kyang rim yod 'tshal/ rten dang bcas tshes la phul zhes phul phab tsam/ bdun pa ni grogs mchog dam pa'i phyag tu/ phul don/ deng sku'i zla snang lhag par gsal zhing / mdzad bzang yar ldan du yod pa legs/ 'dir yang 'di phung bro 'tshal gyis ma gos tsam du gnas/ slad nas nye ba'i lam ba nga chad med kyi 'phros 'os gang gā'i rgyun bzhin mdzod/ rten dang bcas tshes la phul/ zhes pa lta bus mtshon zhing kha yig 'bebs bzos rgya sdoms sogs gong gi sa bcad nas len// // 352
